text: {"components": [{"type": "number", "quote": "rund 100 Sitzungsstunden", "gist": "Approximately 100 session hours per year"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2500 Geschäfte", "gist": "2500 business items per year"}, {"type": "number", "quote": "50 Geschäfte", "gist": "50 business items per weekly session"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "SBRG", "gist": "SBRG (presumably a Swiss administrative body)"}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "prüft ... auf Vollständigkeit und führt die Kontrolle, dass alle Geschäfte rechtzeitig eintreffen", "gist": "SBRG checks completeness and ensures timely arrival of all business items"}, {"type": "condition", "quote": "vier Arbeitstage vor der Bundesratssitzung", "gist": "Four working days before the Federal Council session"}, {"type": "action", "quote": "erstellt anschliessend die Traktandenliste", "gist": "Subsequently creates the agenda list"}, {"type": "action", "quote": "eröffnet das Mitberichtsverfahren, indem der Antrag an alle übrigen Departemente und die Bundeskanzlei verteilt wird", "gist": "Initiates the consultation procedure by distributing the proposal to all other departments and the Federal Chancellery"}]}
